$comment: The site's Content-Security-Policy (W1.2 of PLAN-design.md): the pages at / and everything under it but /app/, which has its own (security/csp.json). `npm run gen:csp` writes it under /* in packages/site/public/_headers, and the app's under /app/*, which detaches this one first.
The site runs no script: script-src falls back to default-src 'none'. A page that needs one gets it by a decision in PLAN-design.md (W3.6).

Styles, images and fonts come from the site's own files only: no inline style (Astro writes its CSS to files with build.inlineStylesheets 'never', and Markdown's syntax highlighting, which writes style attributes, is off).
No third party: the site's pages make no request to another origin (e2e/site.spec.ts). frame-ancestors 'none': nothing frames the site.

connect-src 'self': Lighthouse reads robots.txt with a fetch from inside the page, which default-src 'none' blocked (its SEO audit then scored 92, W2.1). The site runs no script, so nothing of the page's own can use it.
